sourceChecks.text: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文が「ユダの人々」の人数をイスラエル全体と別に数える。

sourceChecks.text: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: イスラエルの歩兵とユダの人々が別に数えられる。

sourceChecks.text: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle; and they were gathered together at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephesdammim.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「ユダに属する」と土地の所属を示す地域用法。

sourceChecks.text: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: イスラエルとユダの人々を集団として並べる。

sourceChecks.text: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: イスラエルとユダの人々を集団として並べる。

sourceChecks.text: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ユダの地またはユダに属する人々を集団・地域として指す。

sourceChecks.text: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ユダの地またはユダに属する人々を集団・地域として指す。

sourceChecks.text: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ユダの地またはユダに属する人々を集団・地域として指す。

sourceChecks.text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文のユダは民・領域または王統を指し、族祖本人を指さない。

sourceChecks.text: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ユダの地またはユダに属する人々を集団・地域として指す。

sourceChecks.text: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ユダの地またはユダに属する人々を集団・地域として指す。

sourceChecks.text: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ユダの地またはユダに属する人々を集団・地域として指す。

sourceChecks.text: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文のユダは民・領域または王統を指し、族祖本人を指さない。
